content: dila nobtomange kwama cwerke bo nobo nin kange nob meranka cwerke anbo kimen. ki an bo ketito yurangum na wuronka ce kange ci an ko teluwe ciye wo tiyen ciye. ci boti ki wuronka wulom dor ciro.
Ducce nawo abwanteng nure ciye, kange morece ci anko nur bilenkere wo yilam durre.
Morkucuno ciye ci an yuwo diger ducce kimen ki ker bi boler ciro. fuwar ciro biyeken fiye wulom. kange wuronka ciko dabo dum.
Nyori kwama dobbo nobtomangem ce wucare woma morkumtacile bwiranke, la nyore kwama tunken ci morkumtacile bware, naci ku, kenci luwe kumtacile tabe, kiduka ningtang bolangti.
Yila ci dobbo kale carko, cin yoken nufu wo meran kereti cakcakeu kange nobo niber, fiye cuwo.
Ci bo ki mwem wuro ka kale nobo nyombo kwama. Kwama nyori twimbi ten codome kange gomora yilam bwiyem, wuro yilam diker nunkaro fintange nobo wo nyombo kwama.
Na lot wo cakcake co nuwa dotange fiye nobo bwanten ner ciyer tiye, nyombo werkun nen.
La nii cakcake wo yim tiber cireu, kume kange kume ner cere ti kayai mor dume cakcake ce dor kekero co towe kange co nuwau.
Teluwe diye nyimom nure ca cokum nobkwamab ti morcuwaka kange nure ca tam nobo mani cakcake na comwe cibi diye bolange.
Wo bilen kere dor nobo ki dilanka bwiyek kange cwe kanka nobo Ki bi kwang keret, dor ciro kucer kange cima dike ci cwiti, maci cwatai nobdutonka.
Nobtomange kwama wucake wi ki bikang kange wo la ciye nyori ci bobo ki kiyange fiye teluwe diye nin.
Nyori bi ciro manki kwa dikeri cin maci na bii tabi biyem. ci cwekan dikero wo ci nymbe, ci anbwiyam.
Ci an fiye nan bwiran nangene ciye ci kwa nuwaka lima ti diye wona lima ce. dor ciro cin twelum, ci nuwo lima nangene ciye bi bolere ti, fiye cuwo ci nuwa lima ti kange kom me.
Ci wi ki nuwe burotum natubem, nobburokab, kero bwir mani lacine ner ci kwou nobo wo ti boyorau mornangene ciye bwiranye, nyori cin cuati ner ciro dor kucunur ci bibei cii ka.
Cin dubom nur bilen ke, cin ko nyori cin bwanteng nure, Balamu bi bwe Be'ore, ni wo bilan fiya ka yokka mordikero kebo cakcake,
Nyori yuwo weranka dor bwiran keret ce, kelba mani tok kere, weran nii tomange kwama wo twelum twele ki dir nifiret.
Nobo buro ci na buir man kimwem na bilor wo yuwa mwe meko yeecu cike kumtacile durwi ningtang ci ti.
Cin nobtokka kerek koni kange nobcwika dorek. ci bol nobo ti fiye dilanka bwiyek. cibol nobo ti, wuro cwiti naci cwam fiye nobo yimbo yorbe.
cin manobo nin cor ciyan cerci, ci ki bwici canga fiye bwiran ke. nyori nii cange fiye dike kwob ner cere.
Ni wo cerum kalenm fiye nyomka teluwe kange nii fuloka yeecu yila nyonti mor burotum bo ni neu, damcembo a cuwa bwir tiye anla kabako bwiraka.
La cinen diker noci nyombo nure nyime cakcake, kange wo ci nyimom di ci dubom werfundo ci ne ciye.
Nuka kereko wo bilenke fiye ci wiye Bicwiye yilaken kwiye ce kange ngyere yilati fiye dwiti”
